newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB no comment on report Advanta bid failed.
newsitem.headline: NAB no comment on report Advanta bid failed.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) on Thursday declined to comment on a report which said the bank had made a bid for U.S.-based credit card issuer, Advanta Corp, and that this bid had been rejected.
The report in the publication, American Banker, said NAB had offered A$57 (US$42) per share for Advanta, valuing the company at A$2.38 billion, but that the bid was turned down.
Advanta shares closed at US$34-7/8 on Wednesday, up from about US$31 before bid rumours started in mid-june.
"It is not the bank's policy to comment on speculative reports," NAB spokesman, Haydn Park told Reuters.
Advanta recorded a surprise first quarter loss in April and was subsequently downgraded by ratings agency Standard & Poors Corp in May.
Media reports have speculated that the troubled group has asked investment banks to explore possible mergers.
At 3.20 p.m (0520 GMT), NAB shares were 13 cents higher at A$19.25. -- Melbourne Bureau 61-3 9286-1435
